node.title: All-admissible-row F2 extras-budget close
node.statement: ROUND-18 REPAIR: prove directly that non-coset-union F2 extras plus trade families are at most n^3=2^123 on every official prize-max admissible row. The July conditional close on growing-order Myerson is not valid at this scope: the 16-rung tower is inadmissible, and (O1) is false whenever ord_n(p)<[F_q:F_p]. The proved empty/edge bands, dictionary, contraction, near-tail, and structural census remain available. The prime-field GRS direct-sum reduction is proved only on the plus branch p=1 mod 4; its attempted all-row extension is refuted by the generating row p=2^61-1, q=p^2. On the minus branch, the top-window kernel is now proved to be one Frobenius-coupled negacyclic root code with exact rank, collision identity, pointwise floor, and ternary distance. The honest attack surface is: plus-branch generating-row GRS ternary mass; minus-branch coupled-code mass; a direct replacement payment on non-generating rows; the PP5.0 average-to-sum seam; and any coset-sensitive use of Frobenius antipodal descent. No consumer status is promoted by this repair.
